caps.title: A {provider} inbox your agent can actually use
caps.sub: Nine action-based MCP tools, not just drafts. Your agent finishes the job inside {provider}.

capabilities.p: List, read and search across folders to find that invoice, summarize a thread, or pull the latest from a sender.
Compose and send real messages, reply in-thread, and forward, directly from your mailbox, not as a draft you finish by hand.
Queue a message to go out at the right time, so your agent can draft now and send on schedule.
Keep the inbox tidy: file mail into folders, flag what matters, archive the rest, or delete on request.

verificationNote.title: Google shows an unverified app screen
verificationNote.body: Google reviews apps that request Gmail access, and mcpemails.com has not been through that review. You will see an unverified app screen during sign-in, with the steps to continue. The connection itself is not time-limited: once connected, an inbox stays connected until you revoke it.

meta.description: IMAP and SMTP settings for {count} email providers, each verified from a live connection, plus how to give Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT access to that mailbox.

hub.title: Connect any mailbox to your AI
hub.lead: mcpemails speaks plain IMAP and SMTP, so it connects almost any mailbox. Below is every provider with a setup guide: the exact hosts and ports, whether you need an app password, and what tends to go wrong.
hub.answer: mcpemails connects to any email provider that offers IMAP and SMTP access, which is nearly all of them. Each guide below lists that provider's verified hostnames, ports and authentication requirements, and one inbox is free forever.
hub.verifiedIntro: Every hostname on these pages was checked on {date} by opening a real TLS connection to it.
hub.genericSub: Any mailbox with IMAP access works. The generic guide covers finding your own host and port.
